label.purpose: Navigation, metadata, hints, and footer text.

components.name: Primary Route Navigation
components.description: Literal route links with monochrome active treatment. Below 64rem they collapse into a hamburger disclosure whose panel centers the four links. The home page has no header at any width.
components.html: /projects/blog/about/contact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; background: #000; font: 400 .9375rem/1.7 "JetBrains Mono", monospace; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; color: #d4d4d4; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: #f5f5f5; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: .35rem; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: .25rem; }

components.name: Home Preview Stage
components.description: Desktop-only hover preview: one flat gray radial glow, the same size for every link, behind the previewed content. With the About page portrait stage it is the only place a gradient, canvas, or WebGL is allowed.
components.css: .ds-stage { position: relative; display: grid; width: min(100%, 34rem); aspect-ratio: 1; place-items: center; background: radial-gradient(closest-side, rgb(255 255 255 / .24), rgb(255 255 255 / .1) 55%, transparent); color: #d4d4d4; font: 400 .9375rem/1.8 "JetBrains Mono", monospace; } .ds-stage-text { margin: 0; }

components.name: Blog Result

components.css: .ds-result { max-width: 82ch; background: #000; color: #d4d4d4; font: 400 1rem/1.65 "JetBrains Mono", monospace; } .ds-result h2 { margin: 0 0 .75rem; color: #f5f5f5; font-size: clamp(1.2rem,1.08rem + .45vw,1.5rem); line-height: 1.35; } .ds-result p { margin: 0 0 .75rem; } .ds-result time { color: #a3a3a3; font-size: .9375rem; } .ds-result a { color: inherit; text-decoration-color: #a3a3a3; text-underline-offset: .22em; } .ds-result a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: .25rem; }

components.description: Centered long-form prose with comfortable measure and rhythm.

components.css: .ds-reading { max-width: 70ch; margin-inline: auto; background: #000; color: #d4d4d4; font: 400 clamp(1rem,.95rem + .2vw,1.0625rem)/1.78 "JetBrains Mono", monospace; } .ds-reading h1 { max-width: 30ch; margin: 0 0 2rem; color: #f5f5f5; font-size: clamp(1.8rem,1.45rem + 1.4vw,2.5rem); line-height: 1.22; letter-spacing: -.025em; }

narrative.overview: The site combines the economy of a Unix manual page with the calm pacing of a small literary publication. Pitch black is the canvas, neutral text carries every hierarchy, and slash-prefixed route names appear only where they explain navigation. The writing is always the product, and plain links reach everything.
keyCharacteristics: Absolute black ground with a neutral gray-to-white hierarchy.
One self-hosted monospace family and no decorative type pairing.
Flat, square, line-based controls without cards or ornamental surfaces.
A centered two-column home (welcome and links left, hover preview right on desktop) beside centered reading columns, with no header on the home page.
Progressive enhancement: plain links and a native disclosure menu work without JavaScript.

rules.name: The No Accent Rule
rules.body: State is expressed with weight, underline, border, and white focus treatment; never introduce a chromatic accent.

rules.name: The Readability Rule
rules.body: Muted text remains real readable text, not low-opacity decoration.

rules.name: The Prose Is Not Preformatted Rule
rules.body: Use semantic paragraphs and natural wrapping; never turn articles into a preformatted text wall.

rules.name: The Flat Document Rule
rules.body: A new surface must earn its boundary through content or interaction; never add card elevation as decoration. The only exceptions are the preview and portrait stages.

rules.name: The Preview Stage Rule
rules.body: A flat gray radial glow, canvas drawing, and WebGL are allowed only inside the home page's desktop preview stage and the About page's portrait stage, never elsewhere, always gray (the shared --glow-gradient), and always reduced or removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

dos: Do keep the page ground pitch black and use only the documented neutral hierarchy.
Do preserve the distinct home, index, and article alignments.
Do use semantic document elements and native controls.
Do keep standalone interactive targets near 2.75rem and show a two-pixel white focus outline.
Do test 320px reflow and long article slugs.
Do keep every preview optional: each destination stays a plain link.
donts: Don't introduce colored accents, or gradients, glows, textures, scanlines, and 3D outside the home preview stage and the About portrait stage.
Don't add cards, dashboard modules, fake window controls, or decorative chrome.
Don't center paragraph text or vertically center long reading pages.
Don't hide layout defects with global overflow clipping.
Don't make a hover preview the only way to reach content.
